injection_scope_note: Only decision units 61-73 are injected, simultaneously, for a given (p, recipe). The envelope fit itself is computed solely from the real, uninjected envelope-era units 1-47 and is identical across every (p, recipe) cell above. The injected similarity metric's trailing window for a decision unit mixes that unit's injected prefix (and any other decision unit inside its window) with the REAL prefixes of non-decision-unit window members -- intended, not an error (task note).
